cl_f_L_per_hr.note: Reported apparent oral clearance for sotorasib.

t_half_hr.note: Reported mean terminal elimination half-life for sotorasib.

tau_hr.note: The planned dose levels are specified as once-daily oral dosing.

fu.note: Estimated from approximately 89% plasma protein binding.

ic50_nM.note: Approximate cellular pERK inhibition IC50 reported for sotorasib in KRAS G12C-mutant cells; the protocol does not specify an assay.

mw.note: Molecular weight of sotorasib in g/mol.
